note: unaccented (heiban) godan verb stays heiban in negative
ば induces its own downstep right before itself on an otherwise-heiban verb (Wiktionary Module:ja-acc-table) — よめ↓ば, not flat
なかった gets a downstep a fixed 3 morae from the end even for a heiban verb — よまな↓かった, not flat
ない always attaches with its own atamadaka accent, landing right before it — はしら↓ない (position 3, i.e. citationMoraCount), not at the citation stem boundary (position 2)
an already-accented verb's ba-form keeps the same absolute mora index as citation — はし↓れば
なかった carries the negative form's own (already-shifted) downstep straight through — はしら↓なかった
